title.narrative: Xinjiang Regional Road Improvement Project (Korla-Kuqa Section)

description.narrative: The Project will facilitate development of a more efficient national and regional transport system in Xinjiang. The Project will result in a more sustainable east-west road corridor in Xinjiang that is economically and socially more efficient, is safer and cleaner, and is better integrated with eastern China, the neighboring countries in the west and the local road network. The Project improves the east-west road transport corridor in Xinjiang, as well as the local road network and road connection to neighboring countries. The Project will comprise of the following components: (i) highway improvement; (ii) local roads improvement; (iii) cross-border transport facilitation; (iv) freight terminals efficiency; (v) rural transport services; (vi) road safety; and (vii) capacity development.

Output: 1. National highway G314 improved and related facilities provided. Indicator: 296.5 km of Korla-Kuqa expressway opened to traffic in 2011 and effectively operated. Progress/Status: The upgrading of the existing G314 was completed in April 2011, except for two minor sections where the expressway crosses the line of railway and two service areas that are under construction, and the upgraded road was opened to public traffic on 1 May 2011. Data Source: Review missions, progress reports, and Project Completion Report (PCR). Actual value:

Output: 2. Local roads improved in the project area. Indicator: 193 km of rural roads reconstructed in 2010 and maintained. Progress/Status: Rehabilitation of the local roads commenced in May 2009. The E01 contract, Wuqia- Dunkuotan road in Kuqa, was completed by August 2010. The nearly completed road of E02 and E03 were damaged significantly During heavy flood in June 2010 in Qiemo. Restoration of the damage was completed in May 2011. For local road from Sutang maintenance office to Aoyiyalake Township in Qiemo County (E02), length of rehabilitation has been reduced to 67.3 km, comparing to the original plan of about 90 km. The goal of change was to utilize a parallel road that was newly constructed by the State Reclamation. A 3.5 km connecting road (Class IV) has been built under contract E02.
Data Source: Review missions, progress reports, and PCR. Actual value:

Output: 5. The capacity of XCD strengthened in road transport. Indicator: At least 145 person-months of national training provided to XCD and local county and township authorities. Progress/Status: A total of 170 people had been trained in various subjects, including project financing and risk control, regulating passenger and freight transport, highway construction and management system, traffic administrative law enforcement, and ecologic highway construction and environmental protection Data Source: Review missions, progress reports, and PCR. Output: 5. The capacity of XCD strengthened in road transport. Indicator: At least 41 person-months of international training provided to XCD.
